summary: Vestand Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a $200,000 loan from Good Mood Studio Inc. with 16% simple interest due September 16, 2026, secured by all equity in Vestand Korea Co., Ltd. No price per share, premium, or ownership change is involved; this is a debt arrangement not a special situation. The report was filed late. Routine debt creation is not a category-defining event.
